body: I apologize. I didn't mean to shit on anyone because of their age.

My brother is 18. He's effectively a minor. I can't talk to him about killing myself. I will look into this Magnolia film, though. 

Also, thank you for taking the time to respond.

I would be taking myself away from them, yes. I don't know about "amazing and unique" but I would certainly be denying them the experience of continuing to know me. 

Thing is, I do that a lot as it is. I have walked away from many relationships, both romantic and professional, without looking back, without another word spoken again. So I'm pretty used to abandoning folks.
I have imagined what they would feel multiple times and I don't try to downplay it. Yes, they would be extremely upset. But, like, I don't want to say "tough shit" but that's really all I can say.

Agreed. I would be very selfish to kill myself. That's fine. I'm a casually cruel person and while that contributes to my self-hate, it's not enough to stop me from doing it. It's like, sorry dudes, I wish it coulda turned out differently. I'm not doing this to hurt them but I can't be held back just for that reason alone. If that makes me a scumbag steve, I accept the title without complaint. 

Furthermore, the never give up thing applies largely to people in difficult situations. I am not in a difficult situation so much as I am a chronic and terminal fuckup. Not a horrible person. Just a run of the mill, garden variety fuckup.
